evidence.quote: This is a server URL for your MCP client, not a page to open directly in a browser.

result.notes: Free tier is self-serve, no credit card required (1,000 monthly credits). Core REST API uses API key via Bearer token; the official hosted MCP server additionally supports OAuth sign-in as an alternative to API key. API surface is small (scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, batch-scrape and related status/webhook endpoints).
result.one_liner: Firecrawl is a web scraping/crawling API that converts websites into clean, LLM-ready markdown/structured data.
